title: Rajani Associates assists Associated Power Structures on securing ₹1,225 crore from Waaree Renewable Tech
description: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited has acquired a 55% stake in Associated Power Structures Private Limited for ₹1,225 crore, through a combination of primary and secondary transactions.Rajani Associates advised Associated Power Structures and its promoters on this transaction.
